text: At 2.1.20 M33 `m33l11sc` says the host does NOT publish `@inharness-ai/claude4spec/plugin-testing` (the harness is an intent, not a contract) and `m33rt001` says the package publishes no subpath besides `…/plugin-runtime`, `…/plugin-runtime/ui` and `…/plugin-runtime/ambient`; the unit removes the published harness. Two criteria still `active` at 2.1.20 require that subpath: `ac-autor-pluginu-typuje-test-przez-d-ts` (an author types a test through the `.d.ts` published under `…/plugin-testing`) and `ac-test-integracyjny-pakietu-pluginu-spo` (an external plugin package's integration test starts the host through `createPluginTestApp` from `@inharness-ai/claude4spec/plugin-testing`). They cannot hold once the subpath is gone. Assumed: the page wins. `./plugin-testing` left `package.json#exports`, `src/plugin-types/plugin-testing.ts` and `src/server/plugin-testing/` were removed (the implementation moved to the internal setup `tests/helpers/plugin-test-setup.ts`), and the tests that carried these two slugs (`plugin-testing.types.test.ts`, `plugin-testing.subprocess.test.ts`) were deleted with it. Both criteria should be deprecated (or reworded as the intended shape, outside the active set). The still-active harness criteria that do not name the subpath (`ac-typ-encji-z-manifestu-przekazanego-do`, `ac-mountcontext-pluginu-uruchomionego-pr`, `ac-dodanie-subpathu-plugin-testing-do-pu`, `ac-lamiaca-zmiana-sygnatury-createplugin`) keep their tests, now against the internal setup.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-2002 — `ac-autor-pluginu-typuje-test-przez-d-ts` and `ac-test-integracyjny-pakietu-pluginu-spo` are still active at 2.1.20 but name the published `…/plugin-testing` subpath, which the page withdraws; their tests went with the subpath and no test carries their slugs.
